passage_annotation_anchor_or_whole_work.name: passage_annotation_anchor_or_whole_work
passage_annotation_anchor_or_whole_work.value: ("passage_annotation"."is_whole_work" = true AND "passage_annotation"."text_block_id" IS NULL) OR ("passage_annotation"."is_whole_work" = false AND "passage_annotation"."text_block_id" IS NOT NULL AND "passage_annotation"."quote" IS NOT NULL)

rag_chunk_exactly_one_eligible_source.name: rag_chunk_exactly_one_eligible_source
rag_chunk_exactly_one_eligible_source.value: ("rag_chunk"."source_type" = 'uploaded' and "rag_chunk"."text_block_id" is not null and "rag_chunk"."research_resource_content_id" is null) or ("rag_chunk"."source_type" = 'open_access' and "rag_chunk"."research_resource_content_id" is not null and "rag_chunk"."text_block_id" is null)

reading_record_exactly_one_target.name: reading_record_exactly_one_target
reading_record_exactly_one_target.value:
(
      (case when "reading_record"."work_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) +
      (case when "reading_record"."bib_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) +
      (case when "reading_record"."learning_resource_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)
    ) = 1

understanding_rating_exactly_one_target.name: understanding_rating_exactly_one_target
understanding_rating_exactly_one_target.value:
(
      (case when "understanding_rating"."work_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) +
      (case when "understanding_rating"."bib_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) +
      (case when "understanding_rating"."learning_resource_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)
    ) = 1
